# Colour Correct

Grades colour: exposure, levels, contrast, saturation, hue, white balance and shadow/midtone/highlight tints.

`lfs.colour_correct` · Colour

## How to use

Start with Exposure to set brightness, then adjust Contrast and Saturation.\
Connect a Selection to grade only part of your scene.\
Reset colour wheels to the centre for neutral shadows, midtones and highlights.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Where you apply the edit, 0–1: 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 applies it fully. Unconnected means everything. |
| Exposure | `Exposure` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.1; soft min -10; soft max 10 | Brightness in stops: +1 doubles the light, −1 halves it. 0, the default, leaves brightness unchanged. |
| Black Point | `Black Point` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01 | Input brightness mapped to black. 0, the default, keeps existing blacks; raising it deepens shadows. |
| White Point | `White Point` | lfs.float | 1 | step 0.01 | Input brightness mapped to white. 1, the default, keeps existing whites; lowering it brightens highlights. |
| Midpoint | `Midpoint` | lfs.float | 0.5 | min 0.01; max 0.99; step 0.01 | Input brightness mapped to mid grey, 0.01–0.99. 0.5 is neutral; lower values lighten midtones. |
| Contrast | `Contrast` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; step 0.01 | Difference between light and dark. 1 keeps it unchanged; 0 makes a flat tone; values above 1 increase contrast. |
| Saturation | `Saturation` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; step 0.01 | Colour strength. 0 removes colour, 1 keeps it unchanged, and values above 1 make colours stronger. |
| Hue Shift | `Hue Shift` | lfs.float | 0 | step 1 | Colour-wheel rotation in degrees. 0 keeps colours unchanged; 180 moves each colour to its opposite. |
| Temperature | `Temperature` | lfs.float | 0 | min -1; max 1; step 0.01 | Warm/cool balance, −1 to 1. Negative values cool the image, positive values warm it; 0 is neutral. |
| Tint | `Tint` | lfs.float | 0 | min -1; max 1; step 0.01 | Green/magenta balance, −1 to 1. Negative values add magenta, positive values add green; 0 is neutral. |
| Shadows | `Shadows` | lfs.colour | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | min -1; max 1; step 0.01 | Colour offset in dark areas, −1 to 1 per channel. 0 is neutral; negative values remove that colour. |
| Midtones | `Midtones` | lfs.colour | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | min -1; max 1; step 0.01 | Colour offset in mid-brightness areas, −1 to 1 per channel. 0 is neutral; positive values add that colour. |
| Highlights | `Highlights` | lfs.colour | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | min -1; max 1; step 0.01 | Colour offset in bright areas, −1 to 1 per channel. 0 is neutral; positive values add that colour. |
| Gamma | `Gamma` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0.001; step 0.01 | Midtone brightness, greater than 0. 1 is neutral; values above 1 lighten midtones and values below 1 darken them. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Auto Range | `auto_range` | bool | false | — | Measure black and white points from the scene. Off by default, so you control both points yourself. |
